sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Metagolem Titans inspired the Jewish myth of the golem, creatures of clay endowed with life, although the modern folklore may refer to any creature brought to life through magic. {{source|Huntik.com/Secret Files|Huntik.com}} According to legend, a weak Seeker once summoned a Metagolem Titan which, unable to be controlled, nearly destroyed an entire city. {{source|Huntik.com}} [[Jodis Lore]] obtained one such Amulet, and at some point hid it within a vase in the [[Golem's Attic]] in [[Prague, Czech Republic]]. {{source|Words of Truth, Heart of Lies}} In the Czech Republic, Metagolem came to be known for defending the Jews living within Prague. {{source|Huntik.com/Secret Files|Huntik.com}}

Eventually, Dante Vale uncovered Jodis Lore's Metagolem Amulet while looking following a clue left in [[Eathon's journal]]. {{source|Words of Truth, Heart of Lies}} After bonding, Dante has since used this Titan in battle during rough situations. {{source|Like Father, Unlike Son}} Dante once hid [[Metagolem]] under the sand to surprise [[Grier]] when they fought on [[Sutos Island]]. {{source|Like Father, Unlike Son}}

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext: Metagolem has an attacking power of 5 and a base defensive power of 3. {{source|Giochi Preziosi|Toy Card}} Being a Titan made almost entirely out of rock, he is extremely durable. This grants Metagolem immense amounts of physical strength in conjunction with its large size. However this also makes him very slow. As such, he is often called upon by Dante for heavy jobs such as breaking down barriers or moving large structures.   Using his '''Stun''' ability, Metagolem can knock down opponents with a single, well-timed strike. {{source|Huntik: Titan Defence}} He can also attack his enemies with his '''Powerful Fists''' ability, launching powerful punches or striking the ground to cause powerful earthquakes. {{source|Giochi Preziosi|Toy Card}}

sections.heading: Design History
sections.wikitext:
Metagolem was designed to be a large, powerful Titan made of dense rock. Though originally imagined as brutish and even clumsy, his design was tweaked to be much more impressive. He also was given gold-accented armor. {{Source|Huntik.com/Secret_Files|Huntik.com}}.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* The word golem comes from the Hebrew word ''gelem'' which means “raw material,” as the mythical [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golem golem] was made from clay. The same word may also be used to mean "soulless body" as the golem required a pure soul to guide it.
* Metagolem's summoning commands include "'''Lend us strength''', "''''Do your worst'''," "'''Get ready'''," "'''Ready for battle'''," and "'''Demolition time'''". In Season 2, his sole command is '''"Clear the way'''".
* His code to unlock him at CW4KIDS and [[Huntik.com]] was METAGOLEM95.

full_text:
Metagolem is an incredibly powerful Titan, but he can be difficult to summon unless his Seeker is in great danger. Confirmed equivalent Titans to Metagolem include the aquatic Coralgolem, the larger Undergolem, the experimental Brahe, and the smaller Chaingolem.

History

Metagolem Titans inspired the Jewish myth of the golem, creatures of clay endowed with life, although the modern folklore may refer to any creature brought to life through magic. [Huntik.com] According to legend, a weak Seeker once summoned a Metagolem Titan which, unable to be controlled, nearly destroyed an entire city. [Huntik.com] Jodis Lore obtained one such Amulet, and at some point hid it within a vase in the Golem's Attic in Prague, Czech Republic. [Words of Truth, Heart of Lies] In the Czech Republic, Metagolem came to be known for defending the Jews living within Prague. [Huntik.com]

Eventually, Dante Vale uncovered Jodis Lore's Metagolem Amulet while looking following a clue left in Eathon's journal. [Words of Truth, Heart of Lies] After bonding, Dante has since used this Titan in battle during rough situations. [Like Father, Unlike Son] Dante once hid Metagolem under the sand to surprise Grier when they fought on Sutos Island. [Like Father, Unlike Son]

Abilities

Metagolem has an attacking power of 5 and a base defensive power of 3. [Toy Card] Being a Titan made almost entirely out of rock, he is extremely durable. This grants Metagolem immense amounts of physical strength in conjunction with its large size. However this also makes him very slow. As such, he is often called upon by Dante for heavy jobs such as breaking down barriers or moving large structures. Using his Stun ability, Metagolem can knock down opponents with a single, well-timed strike. [Huntik: Titan Defence] He can also attack his enemies with his Powerful Fists ability, launching powerful punches or striking the ground to cause powerful earthquakes. [Toy Card]

Design History

Metagolem was designed to be a large, powerful Titan made of dense rock. Though originally imagined as brutish and even clumsy, his design was tweaked to be much more impressive. He also was given gold-accented armor. [Huntik.com].

Trivia

• The word golem comes from the Hebrew word gelem which means “raw material,” as the mythical golem was made from clay. The same word may also be used to mean "soulless body" as the golem required a pure soul to guide it.
• Metagolem's summoning commands include "Lend us strength, "Do your worst," "Get ready," "Ready for battle," and "Demolition time". In Season 2, his sole command is "Clear the way".
• His code to unlock him at CW4KIDS and Huntik.com was METAGOLEM95.
